# Cncf Azure Registry Reviewer

Review Azure Registry using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Container Registry category. Azure Container Registry allows you to store images for all types of container deployments including DC/OS, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, and Azure services such as App Service, Batch, Service Fabric, and others.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
